# Prof. Dr. Dries Faems

> GenAI expert and Chair of Entrepreneurship, Innovation & Technological Transformation at WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management. Specializes in generative AI workshops and training for businesses, covering ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and Gemini.

Website: https://driesfaems.github.io/website/

## About
- Academic: Chair of Entrepreneurship, Innovation & Technological Transformation, WHU Otto Beisheim School of Management.
- Author of 6,000+ citations in academic research on innovation, entrepreneurship, and technology management.
- Leads WHU's partnership with OpenAI.
- Runs the "GenAI Nerd Channel" on YouTube, providing free AI training content.

## AI Workshops & Training Programs
- Online GenAI Bootcamp: 3-week intensive training on generative AI tools and trends (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini) for business professionals, no coding experience required.
- Innovation & Corporate Entrepreneurship Program: executive education with hands-on generative AI tool applications.
- Custom Corporate AI Workshops: tailored GenAI training for an organization's specific industry, use cases, and objectives, including hands-on demonstrations.

## AI Contributions
- GenAI Nerd Channel (YouTube): https://www.youtube.com/@GenAI_Nerd_Channel
- WHU–OpenAI partnership lead.
